name: Pwndoc
author: RequestReaver
description: Connect to a Pwndoc instance to browse reports and the vulnerability database, and add vulnerabilities, findings and audits.
features: Browse all reports and the vulnerability database
Filter vulnerabilities by language, category or search
Add new vulnerabilities to the database
Add findings to an existing report (from the database or from scratch)
Create new audits — respecting custom fields and templates

config.name: insecure
config.label: Allow self-signed certificate
config.help: Enable for a local or self-hosted instance that uses a self-signed TLS certificate.

notes: Interactive report + finding editor with live collaboration.
Browse reports + the vulnerability database; add vulnerabilities, findings and audits via the native Pwndoc API, respecting custom fields and templates.
